verdict.rationale: Airbyte connections support scheduled, cron, and manual sync scheduling, plus API/Terraform/PyAirbyte for programmatic orchestration, which allows recurring jobs to be scheduled and managed. However, this is a general data-sync scheduling feature, not something purpose-built for AI-native agent workflows beyond invoking syncs via API/MCP. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific workflow orchestration (e.g., agent-triggered conditional workflows, not just cron/manual sync), and independent/hands-on confirmation that scheduling works reliably at scale.
